answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Reaching the plume of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, taxed when attestations come from one subnet. Each submission hangs on the pigment of a task receipt, and the pulse is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
